attributes.board_name: Hawaii Board of Psychology (DCCA Professional & Vocational Licensing)

rules.new_licensee_rule: First-time licensees (and, from July 1, 2026, associate psychologists licensed under HRS 465-7.2) are exempt from CE for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Certify compliance under oath at renewal; random audits, documentation due within 60 days of notice.
rules.notes: 18 credit hours within every biennium (July 1-June 30); all licenses renew by June 30 of even years. Extension by notarized affidavit requires at least 36 h in the next biennium. Topic/provider rules in HAR ch. 16-98 not verified (scanned PDF).
